invoice_types.name: A.6 Viajes, alojamientos y dietas
invoice_types.description: AEXCID A.6 Travel, accommodation and subsistence of project staff and target population: flights (UNHAS, air tickets, boarding passes), hotel/lodging, taxis/transport tickets, per diems, and fuel for project vehicles (carburant/gasoil/essence for a vehicle, véhicule, monitoring trips). Not generator fuel (FUNCIONAMIENTO), not vehicle repair or maintenance (SERV_TECNICOS), not goods purchases (EQUIPOS/CONSUMIBLES).
invoice_types.what_to_look_for: Facturas de gastos de viaje (AEXCID A.6). Documentos típicos: billetes de avión/tren, tarjeta de embarque (boarding pass, obligatoria para vuelos, clase económica), facturas de hotel, recibos de taxi/transporte, liquidaciones de dietas, facturas de carburante para vehículos del proyecto (indicar el vehículo). Buscar: importe total, fecha, nombre del viajero, destino, motivo del viaje. Las dietas deben indicar número de días y tarifa diaria. A menudo hay múltiples páginas con gastos desglosados. Palabras clave positivas: Boarding Pass, Hotel Receipt, Passenger, viajero, destino, dieta, per diem, billet, hébergement, carburant véhicule. El seguro del vehículo va a EQUIPOS y su mantenimiento o reparación a SERV_TECNICOS. El carburant para groupe électrogène (generador) es FUNCIONAMIENTO, no VIAJES. No clasificar como VIAJES si el paquete trata principalmente de compra de bienes, solicitud de compra, procurement, bid summary, supplier quotation, payment voucher, wheat flour, equipment, materials or consumables; esos casos pertenecen normalmente a EQUIPOS o CONSUMIBLES.

invoice_types.name: A.5.a Personal local
invoice_types.description: AEXCID A.5.a Local staff employed under the labour law of the country of implementation: payslips (bulletin de paie), salaries, social security and income tax withholdings, and humanitarian cash-for-work or cash grants. Not volunteer bonuses or primes for animateurs or relais communautaires (VOLUNTARIOS), not headquarters staff (PERS_SEDE).
invoice_types.what_to_look_for: Nóminas y costes laborales de personal contratado localmente con contrato laboral (AEXCID A.5.a). Documentos: nómina mensual, bulletin de paie, recibo de salario, contrato de trabajo, TC2/RNT de Seguridad Social o equivalente (CNPS). Extraer: nombre del trabajador, período (mes/año), salario bruto, retención IRPF, cuota SS empleado, cuota SS empresa, salario neto. Buscar cabeceras: Nómina, Salario, Haberes, Deducciones, Seguridad Social, IRPF, Salaire brut, Net à payer. En proyectos de acción humanitaria, cash for work y transferencias monetarias también van aquí (recibo firmado por el perceptor). Las primas o décharges de voluntarios (animateur, relais communautaire, personnel volontaire) sin contrato laboral son VOLUNTARIOS, no PERS_LOCAL.

invoice_types.name: A.5.b Personal en sede (Extremadura)
invoice_types.description: AEXCID A.5.b Staff based permanently in Extremadura (headquarters): Spanish payslips (nómina), IRPF, Seguridad Social, share of time allocated to the project.
invoice_types.what_to_look_for: Costes de personal en sede, con trabajo permanente en Extremadura (AEXCID A.5.b). Estructura similar a personal local pero bajo normativa española: nómina, IRPF (modelos 110/111/190), Seguridad Social (TC1/TC2). Puede incluir porcentaje de dedicación al proyecto. Extraer los mismos campos que nómina local. Prestar atención a: porcentaje de imputación, período de dedicación, coste total vs coste imputado al proyecto.

invoice_types.name: A.4.a Equipos (bienes inventariables)
invoice_types.description: AEXCID A.4.a Capital assets: durable, non-consumable goods with a useful life over one year (machinery, furniture, IT equipment, transport equipment, vehicles), including their shipping, customs, installation, registration and vehicle insurance. Not repairs or maintenance (SERV_TECNICOS), not consumable supplies (CONSUMIBLES), not the partner's routine office costs (FUNCIONAMIENTO).
invoice_types.what_to_look_for: Facturas de compra de equipos y bienes inventariables duraderos, vida útil superior a un año (AEXCID A.4.a): maquinaria, mobiliario, equipos informáticos, equipos de transporte, vehículos, incluida instalación, puesta en marcha, transporte, aduanas, matriculación y seguro. Documentos: factura de proveedor, albarán, orden de compra, purchase request, procurement bid summary, supplier quotation, cheque/payment voucher, acta de entrega. Extraer: proveedor, NIF/RCCM del proveedor, cliente, número de factura, fecha, descripción detallada del equipo, cantidad, precio unitario, base imponible, IVA, total. Los equipos de alto valor pueden requerir número de serie para el registro de activos; por encima de 15.000 EUR se exigen tres presupuestos. Buscar: Factura, NIF proveedor, modelo, referencia, purchase order, quotation, bid summary, payment voucher. NO incluye reparaciones ni mantenimiento (réparation, entretien, main d'oeuvre, pièces de rechange para reparar): eso es SERV_TECNICOS.

invoice_types.name: A.4.c Consumibles
invoice_types.description: AEXCID A.4.c Consumable materials and supplies used up by project activities (office and school supplies, printer cartridges, kits for pupils, hygiene and medical consumables, food items such as wheat flour, coffee break items), plus their shipping and customs. Not repairs, maintenance, printing/photocopying or security services (SERV_TECNICOS), not fuel, communications or supplies for the partner's own premises (FUNCIONAMIENTO), not durable equipment (EQUIPOS).
invoice_types.what_to_look_for: Facturas de material fungible y consumibles de las actividades del proyecto (AEXCID A.4.c): papelería, material de oficina, cartuchos de impresora, fournitures scolaires, kits para alumnos, fungible informático, material sanitario, alimentos o suministros no duraderos, más transporte y aduanas. Estructura más sencilla que equipos, sin necesidad de registro de activos. Extraer: proveedor, NIF/RCCM del proveedor, cliente, fecha, descripción de artículos, base imponible, IVA, total. Pueden ser tickets, facturas simplificadas, purchase requests, supplier quotations, bid summaries or payment vouchers. Ejemplos típicos: wheat flour, office supplies, hygiene materials, medical consumables. NO incluye: reparación y mantenimiento (réparation, entretien, main d'oeuvre) ni servicios de fotocopias, impresión, audiovisuales o seguridad, que son SERV_TECNICOS; ni carburante (vehículo: VIAJES; groupe électrogène: FUNCIONAMIENTO); ni crédito de communication, tarjetas SIM o datos (FUNCIONAMIENTO); ni compras para la oficina o vivienda del personal.

invoice_types.name: A.5.d Personal voluntario
invoice_types.description: AEXCID A.5.d Volunteer staff without an employment contract: monthly bonuses or allowances (prime, décharge de prime, indemnité) paid to volunteers such as an animateur (e.g. of accelerated education courses), relais communautaire / community relay or personnel volontaire, usually a signed receipt for a fixed amount; also volunteers' insurance and accommodation rent. No payslip with gross/net salary, income tax or social security (that is PERS_LOCAL).
invoice_types.what_to_look_for: Pagos a personal voluntario sin relación laboral (AEXCID A.5.d, Ley 45/2015 del Voluntariado). Documentos típicos: décharge de prime (recibo firmado por el voluntario), fiche de paiement de prime, état de paiement, demande de fonds interna, acuerdo de voluntariado, contrato o carta de asignación, documento que fija el importe de la prima. Términos frecuentes en francés: prime mensuelle, décharge, animateur des cours accélérés, relais communautaire, personnel volontaire, bénévole, indemnité, payé par. Extraer: nombre del voluntario (persona, nunca el cargo), período (mes/año) al que corresponde la prima, función o actividad, importe, moneda, fecha del recibo, forma de pago y quién pagó o autorizó. No buscar salario bruto, neto, IRPF ni seguridad social: un voluntario no tiene nómina. Comprobar que el mes del recibo coincide con el período imputado. También puede incluir seguros de accidente/enfermedad/responsabilidad civil y alquiler de alojamiento del voluntario en el país de ejecución.

invoice_types.name: A.7 Servicios técnicos y profesionales
invoice_types.description: AEXCID A.7 Technical and professional services without an employment relationship: repair and maintenance of vehicles, generators and equipment (réparation, entretien, vidange, main d'oeuvre, forfait main d'oeuvre, garage, spare parts fitted during a repair), consultancy, technical assistance, training and seminar organisation (formation), studies, reports, publications, design and layout, printing/photocopying, audiovisual and security services. Not purchases of goods (EQUIPOS/CONSUMIBLES); identification, works and audit services go to their own lines.
invoice_types.what_to_look_for: Facturas de servicios técnicos y profesionales sin relación laboral (AEXCID A.7). Incluye: reparación y mantenimiento de vehículos, generadores (groupe électrogène) y equipos, con mano de obra y piezas (réparation, entretien périodique, vidange, main d'oeuvre, forfait main d'oeuvre, garage, soudure, pièces de rechange, filtre, huile moteur); consultoría, asistencia técnica, asesoría; organización de formaciones y seminarios (formation des enseignants); estudios, informes, publicaciones, diseño y maquetación; servicios de fotocopias, impresión, audiovisuales y seguridad. Justificación según la norma: contrato de servicio o documento equivalente y factura que especifique las tareas, la duración o tiempo estimado y la tarifa; por encima de 15.000 EUR se exigen tres presupuestos. Extraer: proveedor, NIF/RCCM del proveedor, cliente, número de factura, fecha, descripción de las tareas, vehículo o equipo reparado (matrícula), duración, tarifa, total, moneda, forma de pago. NO incluye la compra de bienes nuevos (EQUIPOS o CONSUMIBLES), ni servicios de identificación/formulación, obras o auditoría/evaluación, que tienen su propia partida.

invoice_types.name: A.8 Funcionamiento
invoice_types.description: AEXCID A.8 Routine operating costs of the local partner's office or base: electricity and water bills, fuel for a generator (carburant pour groupe électrogène / générateur), solar lighting and energy for the base, communications (crédit de communication, phone credit, SIM cards, internet, data bundles), cleaning, security/guarding and upkeep of the premises, office or premises rent. Not vehicle fuel (VIAJES), not repair of vehicles or equipment (SERV_TECNICOS), not routine staff housing.
invoice_types.what_to_look_for: Gastos corrientes de funcionamiento del socio local (AEXCID A.8): electricidad, agua, carburante para el generador de la base (carburant/gasoil pour groupe électrogène, générateur), energía e iluminación solar de la base, comunicaciones (crédit de communication, recharges, cartes SIM, Airtel, Moov, internet, forfait data), limpieza, seguridad/gardiennage y mantenimiento ordinario del local, alquiler de oficinas o locales (loyer, contrat de bail). Justificación: facturas o documentos con validez legal y, para alquileres, el contrato. Tope: 2% de la subvención. Extraer: proveedor, NIF/RCCM del proveedor, cliente, número de factura, fecha, descripción, período facturado, total, moneda, forma de pago. NO incluye: carburante para vehículos (VIAJES), reparación de vehículos, generadores o equipos (SERV_TECNICOS), vivienda habitual del personal (no subvencionable).

rules.name: expense description sufficient
rules.description: The travel expense is described precisely enough to justify it for the project: who travelled, route or destination, dates and purpose. Fuel invoices name the vehicle (plate number) or generator the fuel was for; parking, taxi or transport tickets state the trip or activity they relate to. Fails for vague descriptions.
rules.hint: Quote the description you read. Missing plate numbers on vehicle costs are a failure.

rules.name: project execution within period
rules.description: The document date (invoice or receipt issue date, or the pay period for payroll and allowances) is between the configured limit and the configured limit inclusive, and any payment date shown is on or after the configured limit. Fails if a date is outside this window; state the date found.
rules.hint: Use the issue date of the invoice or receipt, or the period paid for payroll and allowances.

rules.name: proof of payment attached
rules.description: Proof of payment for this expense is attached and fits the payment method: (a) cash: the invoice or a receipt is signed or stamped by the supplier with the payment date and a mention such as 'payé', 'reçu', 'acquitté', 'pour acquit', 'cash', 'paid' or 'received'; (b) cheque: a copy of the cheque made out to the supplier plus the bank statement showing it was debited; (c) bank transfer: the bank statement or transfer confirmation showing the debit. The amount paid matches the invoice total. The method stated on the invoice matches the evidence (an invoice stating payment by transfer or cheque is not proven by a cash note). If one payment (cheque, transfer or cash advance) covers several invoices, a breakdown showing this invoice's amount within that payment is attached. Fails if proof is missing, does not fit the method or amount, or a combined payment has no breakdown.
rules.hint: Identify the payment method first (invoice wording, cheque, bank document, receipt), then check the evidence that method requires. Name the page_num of each proof.

rules.name: documentation match
rules.description: Supporting documents in the file (funds or purchase request, pro forma or quote, purchase order, delivery note, payment voucher, cheque, discharge/décharge) agree with the invoice in amount, quantity, item description and period, and their dates follow a plausible order: request, quote and order on or before the invoice date; payment on or after the invoice date unless the invoice states it was an advance payment. Fails on any contradiction between documents (e.g. a quote for a different quantity, an order for different items, a discharge for a different month, a request dated after the payment). Passes if the invoice has no supporting documents.
rules.hint: List each supporting page with its date, amount and quantity, then compare with the invoice. Name the page_num of any contradiction.

rules.name: non eligible expense
rules.description: The expense is not a non-eligible cost: promotion of the organisation itself or its partners, bank or debit interest, fines, penalties, surcharges or late-payment charges, legal or court costs, protocol or hospitality expenses (gifts, flowers, decorations, receptions, meals with guests, show tickets), severance pay, or depreciation of previously bought assets. Fails if any line is such a cost; name the line.
rules.hint: Read every line item and flag only clearly non-eligible items.

rules.name: aexcid stamp complete
rules.description: Every expense document in the file (invoice, receipt, payslip or allowance receipt) charged to AEXCID bears the AEXCID funding stamp, and the stamp shows all four items: (1) the project file number (expediente; expected: any file number); (2) the caption 'funded by AEXCID-Junta de Extremadura' in any language; (3) the percentage charged to AEXCID, written even when it is 100%; (4) the amount charged to AEXCID, which equals that percentage of the document total and does not exceed it. Fails if the stamp is missing on any expense document or any of the four items is blank, illegible or inconsistent with the total.
rules.hint: Find the AEXCID rubber stamp (usually near the total or the signature). Check the four items one by one and name the missing one.

rules.name: invoice arithmetic correct
rules.description: Arithmetic is correct on every invoice and receipt in the file: for each line, quantity × unit price equals the line total; the line totals add up to the stated total (after any discount, tax or deposit shown); and where the total is also written in words (e.g. 'Arrêtée la présente facture à la somme de ...'), the amount in words equals the amount in figures. Ignore differences of 1 currency unit or less. When it fails, name the line and both values.
rules.hint: Recompute every line yourself instead of trusting the printed line totals. Convert the amount in words to a number before comparing.

rules.name: supplier identification complete
rules.description: Each invoice identifies the supplier with: business or person name, an address (street, district or town), and a tax identification number (NIF) or a company/trade register number (RCCM or equivalent). Fails if the name or address is missing, or if both the tax ID and the register number are missing. A receipt from an informal-market supplier with no invoice obligation passes if it shows the supplier's name and signature.
rules.hint: Look in the letterhead, header and footer for NIF, RCCM, N° contribuable or registre du commerce.

rules.name: client identification complete
rules.description: Each invoice is made out to the beneficiary organisation, a consortium partner or the local partner, written with its full legal name (accepted names: not configured; any full legal name of the organisation). Fails if the client is missing, is a private person, or is only an acronym or short name instead of the full legal name.
rules.hint: Read the 'Client', 'Doit', 'Facturé à' or 'Bill to' field.

rules.name: tax treatment stated
rules.description: Each invoice states its tax treatment: a VAT/TVA or equivalent local tax amount, or an explicit statement that tax is included ('TTC', 'TVA incluse', 'VAT included', 'IVA incluido'), or a stated exemption or non-liability (e.g. 'exonéré', 'non assujetti', 'TVA non applicable', reference to an exemption or simplified tax regime). Fails if the invoice shows amounts excluding tax ('HT', 'hors taxes') with no tax line, no 'tax included' statement and no exemption. A receipt from an informal-market supplier with no invoice obligation passes.
rules.hint: Look at the totals block and the footer. 'HT' alone, without a tax line, 'TTC' or an exemption, is a failure.

rules.name: single expense documents
rules.description: All pages relate to the same expense (same supplier or payee, amount, date and purpose). Fails if (a) a page belongs to a different expense (different amount, supplier, payee or date with no link to this one), or (b) the file contains several invoices or receipts, from different suppliers or for different amounts, without a settlement statement that lists each one and reconciles them to the total paid (e.g. the settlement of a cash advance). Name the page_num of each unrelated page.
rules.hint: Compare amount, supplier and date on every page with the main document. Several receipts are fine only with a statement that adds them up.

rules.name: budget line fit
rules.description: The expense belongs under AEXCID line A.6 Travel, accommodation and subsistence: transport tickets, accommodation, subsistence, or fuel for project trips. rules.hint: Judge only what the documents show; there is no approved budget to compare against.

Fails on any contradiction between documents. Passes if there are no supporting documents.
rules.hint: List each supporting page with its date, amount and quantity, then compare with the invoice. Name the page_num of any contradiction.

rules.name: single expense documents
rules.description: All pages relate to the same expense (same supplier or payee, amount, date and purpose). Fails if (a) a page belongs to a different expense (different amount, supplier, payee or date with no link to this one), or (b) the file contains several invoices or receipts, from different suppliers or for different amounts, without a settlement statement that lists each one and reconciles them to the total paid (e.g. the settlement of a cash advance). Name the page_num of each unrelated page.
rules.hint: Compare amount, supplier and date on every page with the main document. Several receipts are fine only with a statement that adds them up.

rules.name: expense description sufficient
rules.description: The equipment or materials are described precisely enough to identify each item and justify it for the project: item name, brand or model, and quantity; for vehicles, machinery, IT equipment or generators, the serial number, chassis number or plate when available. Fails for vague descriptions such as 'divers', 'matériel' or 'fournitures' with no detail.
rules.hint: Quote the description you read. Missing plate numbers on vehicle costs are a failure.

rules.name: project execution within period
rules.description: The document date (invoice or receipt issue date, or the pay period for payroll and allowances) is between the configured limit and the configured limit inclusive, and any payment date shown is on or after the configured limit. Fails if a date is outside this window; state the date found.
rules.hint: Use the issue date of the invoice or receipt, or the period paid for payroll and allowances.

rules.name: proof of payment attached
rules.description: Proof of payment for this expense is attached and fits the payment method: (a) cash: the invoice or a receipt is signed or stamped by the supplier with the payment date and a mention such as 'payé', 'reçu', 'acquitté', 'pour acquit', 'cash', 'paid' or 'received'; (b) cheque: a copy of the cheque made out to the supplier plus the bank statement showing it was debited; (c) bank transfer: the bank statement or transfer confirmation showing the debit. The amount paid matches the invoice total. The method stated on the invoice matches the evidence (an invoice stating payment by transfer or cheque is not proven by a cash note). If one payment (cheque, transfer or cash advance) covers several invoices, a breakdown showing this invoice's amount within that payment is attached. Fails if proof is missing, does not fit the method or amount, or a combined payment has no breakdown.
rules.hint: Identify the payment method first (invoice wording, cheque, bank document, receipt), then check the evidence that method requires. Name the page_num of each proof.

rules.name: documentation match
rules.description: Supporting documents in the file (funds or purchase request, pro forma or quote, purchase order, delivery note, payment voucher, cheque, discharge/décharge) agree with the invoice in amount, quantity, item description and period, and their dates follow a plausible order: request, quote and order on or before the invoice date; payment on or after the invoice date unless the invoice states it was an advance payment. Fails on any contradiction between documents (e.g. a quote for a different quantity, an order for different items, a discharge for a different month, a request dated after the payment). Passes if the invoice has no supporting documents.
rules.hint: List each supporting page with its date, amount and quantity, then compare with the invoice. Name the page_num of any contradiction.

rules.name: three quotes required
rules.description: If this purchase of supplies, equipment or services exceeds the configured limit, or construction or renovation works exceed the configured limit, at least three quotes from different suppliers (or a documented justification that there are not enough suppliers) are attached. Contracts must not be split to stay under the threshold. Passes when the amount is below the threshold.

rules.name: non eligible expense
rules.description: The expense is not a non-eligible cost: promotion of the organisation itself or its partners, bank or debit interest, fines, penalties, surcharges or late-payment charges, legal or court costs, protocol or hospitality expenses (gifts, flowers, decorations, receptions, meals with guests, show tickets), severance pay, or depreciation of previously bought assets. Fails if any line is such a cost; name the line.
rules.hint: Read every line item and flag only clearly non-eligible items.

rules.name: aexcid stamp complete
rules.description: Every expense document in the file (invoice, receipt, payslip or allowance receipt) charged to AEXCID bears the AEXCID funding stamp, and the stamp shows all four items: (1) the project file number (expediente; expected: any file number); (2) the caption 'funded by AEXCID-Junta de Extremadura' in any language; (3) the percentage charged to AEXCID, written even when it is 100%; (4) the amount charged to AEXCID, which equals that percentage of the document total and does not exceed it. Fails if the stamp is missing on any expense document or any of the four items is blank, illegible or inconsistent with the total.

rules.name: invoice arithmetic correct

Ignore differences of 1 currency unit or less. When it fails, name the line and both values.

rules.name: supplier identification complete
rules.description: Each invoice identifies the supplier with: business or person name, an address (street, district or town), and a tax identification number (NIF) or a company/trade register number (RCCM or equivalent). A receipt from an informal-market supplier with no invoice obligation passes if it shows the supplier's name and signature.
rules.hint: Look in the letterhead, header and footer for NIF, RCCM, N° contribuable or registre du commerce.

Fails if the client is missing, is a private person, or is only an acronym or short name instead of the full legal name.
rules.hint: Read the 'Client', 'Doit', 'Facturé à' or 'Bill to' field.

rules.name: tax treatment stated
rules.description: Each invoice states its tax treatment: a VAT/TVA or equivalent local tax amount, or an explicit statement that tax is included ('TTC', 'TVA incluse', 'VAT included', 'IVA incluido'), or a stated exemption or non-liability (e.g. 'exonéré', 'non assujetti', 'TVA non applicable', reference to an exemption or simplified tax regime). Fails if the invoice shows amounts excluding tax ('HT', 'hors taxes') with no tax line, no 'tax included' statement and no exemption. A receipt from an informal-market supplier with no invoice obligation passes.
rules.hint: Look at the totals block and the footer. 'HT' alone, without a tax line, 'TTC' or an exemption, is a failure.

rules.name: documentation match
rules.description: Supporting documents in the file (funds or purchase request, pro forma or quote, purchase order, delivery note, payment voucher, cheque, discharge/décharge) agree with the invoice in amount, quantity, item description and period, and their dates follow a plausible order: request, quote and order on or before the invoice date; payment on or after the invoice date unless the invoice states it was an advance payment. Fails on any contradiction between documents (e.g. a quote for a different quantity, an order for different items, a discharge for a different month, a request dated after the payment). Passes if the invoice has no supporting documents.
rules.hint: List each supporting page with its date, amount and quantity, then compare with the invoice. Name the page_num of any contradiction.

rules.name: single expense documents
rules.description: All pages relate to the same expense (same supplier or payee, amount, date and purpose). Fails if (a) a page belongs to a different expense (different amount, supplier, payee or date with no link to this one), or (b) the file contains several invoices or receipts, from different suppliers or for different amounts, without a settlement statement that lists each one and reconciles them to the total paid (e.g. the settlement of a cash advance). Name the page_num of each unrelated page.
rules.hint: Compare amount, supplier and date on every page with the main document. Several receipts are fine only with a statement that adds them up.

rules.name: project execution within period
rules.description: The document date (invoice or receipt issue date, or the pay period for payroll and allowances) is between the configured limit and the configured limit inclusive, and any payment date shown is on or after the configured limit. Fails if a date is outside this window; state the date found.
rules.hint: Use the issue date of the invoice or receipt, or the period paid for payroll and allowances.

rules.name: expense description sufficient
rules.description: The operating cost is described precisely: the service or good, the period covered (utilities, rent, communications), and the premises or site. Fuel or maintenance for a vehicle names the vehicle (plate number); fuel or maintenance for a generator names the generator or site; parking or transport tickets state the trip or activity. Fails for vague descriptions.
rules.hint: Quote the description you read. Missing plate numbers on vehicle costs are a failure.

rules.name: rental contract present
rules.description: If the expense is rent of premises or offices, the lease contract is attached and shows landlord, tenant, price, payment method and term (AEXCID A.8). Passes for other operating costs.
rules.hint: Only applies to rent ('loyer', 'location', 'bail').

rules.name: budget line fit
rules.description: The expense belongs under AEXCID line A.8 Operation: the local partner's routine running costs (electricity, water, communications, maintenance, security, cleaning, rent of premises). Fails if it is mainly durable equipment or a new installation (A.4.a), consumables for project activities (A.4.c), technical services (A.7), or travel (A.6).
rules.hint: Judge only what the documents show; there is no approved budget to compare against.

rules.name: three quotes required
rules.description: If this purchase of supplies, equipment or services exceeds the configured limit, at least three quotes from different suppliers (or a documented justification that there are not enough suppliers) are attached. Contracts must not be split to stay under the threshold. Passes when the amount is below the threshold.
rules.hint: Compare the invoice total with the threshold in the same currency, then look for quotes or a bid summary.

rules.name: non eligible expense
rules.description: The expense is not a non-eligible cost: promotion of the organisation itself or its partners, bank or debit interest, fines, penalties, surcharges or late-payment charges, legal or court costs, protocol or hospitality expenses (gifts, flowers, decorations, receptions, meals with guests, show tickets), severance pay, or depreciation of previously bought assets. Fails if any line is such a cost; name the line.
rules.hint: Read every line item and flag only clearly non-eligible items.
